name: Multi-asset contract COLA override per asset (keying bug)
what_it_tests: Contract override COLA percents must apply per asset on a multi-asset contract; AssetContractQueryHelper keying by ContractId only collapses 3 of 4 assets to the CMDT default with a mislabeled source
proc_mechanism: AssetContractQueryHelper.cls query groups by ContractId only, losing per-asset distinctness; prehook per-ACR keying unaffected; Contract_COLA_Override_Percent__c joined per asset
expected_behavior: Each asset uses its own Contract_COLA_Override_Percent__c, not collapsed to the first match -> 4 distinct UnitPrices
test_setup: Contract with 4 related assets, each with a distinct override rate, COLA renewal quote for all 4

run3_result.actual: Adversarial re-verify on current V21 (v67.0): (1) The keying bug in AssetContractQueryHelper is REAL at the Apex code level -- live probe F05_PROBE on queryAssetContracts({RVDN,RVDO,RVDP,RVDQ}) returns rowsReturned=1 (only RVDQ survives), MISSING={RVDN,RVDO,RVDP}; buildResults Map<Id,Id> keyed by ContractId last-write-wins. BUT this is the COLAUpliftHandler.handleBeforeInsert Apex trigger + helper, NOT V21 steps 26-28. (2) The bug is LATENT: it only drops a needed override when one QLI-insert covers >=2 assets on the same activated override contract. NO such quote exists in the org -- every renewal/amendment quote sourcing RVDN/RVDO/RVDP/RVDQ renews exactly ONE asset, so the collapse never drops a needed row in real data (matches SC-3354 peer-review item C-2, marked 'No (latent)').
